summary: First-finish smoke test of WETAZZ OS. 27 backend checks executed against public API, plus frontend home/login/dashboard verified. Almost all backend endpoints work (seed, business, login, CRM CRUD, vehicles, guest+auth bookings, jobs CRUD + status + labour timers + detail, quotes with GST calc, quote status flow, invoices, comms, reviews + low-rating alert, staff CRUD, analytics, Stripe DEPOSIT+INVOICE checkout w/ session URL, payment status, rego/VIN lookup NOT_CONFIGURED, RBAC 403). One CRITICAL bug: POST /api/auth/signup returns 500 (ObjectId serialization). AI photo-estimate returns 500 with tiny 1x1 png (low priority per request); AI assistant chat returns reply OK. Frontend home hero renders, owner login redirects to /os dashboard with all tiles + kanban buckets showing live data.
passed: POST /api/jobs, PATCH /jobs/{id}/status, labour start/stop, GET /jobs/{id} detail includes quotes+invoices+communications
POST /api/quotes returns gst=67.5 total=742.5 (10% GST correct)
Frontend home page hero renders (Wetazz, Precision Paint...)
Frontend /login with owner@wetazz.com.au -> redirects to /os dashboard with tiles (Open Jobs, Receivable, Jobs by Status buckets) visible

failed.issue: POST /api/auth/signup returns HTTP 500 due to ObjectId serialization. Root cause: signup() inserts `doc` into db.users and then returns `{'user': {k:v for k,v in doc.items() if k != 'password'}}` — but does NOT pop `_id` that motor mutates onto the dict after insert_one, so FastAPI's jsonable_encoder fails with `TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable`. Fix: add `doc.pop('_id', None)` (and same for `cust`) before building the response in /api/auth/signup.
failed.evidence: backend.err.log: ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable")] at fastapi/encoders.py while serializing signup response.

failed.issue: POST /api/ai/photo-estimate returns 500 when given a 1x1 png (likely Claude rejects tiny/blank image). Endpoint raises HTTPException(500) instead of gracefully returning `{raw:'', estimate:null, disclaimer:...}`. Consider wrapping in try/except and returning disclaimer + null estimate so frontend can still show the disclaimer panel.

action_items: Fix POST /api/auth/signup: pop `_id` from `doc` and `cust` before returning (blocks customer signup flow, portal redirect test, and customer-side quote approve E2E)
Optional: make /api/ai/photo-estimate degrade gracefully on AI upstream failure so UI still renders disclaimer
